$comment: Stable ID enums the API expects as raw integers or strings. Each SDK generates idiomatic enums from this file. Sources are in the app repo, paths relative to app/rails/app/javascript unless noted.

TrendingDuration.notes: Real GraphQL enum; codegen owns it. Listed so SDK docs can link here.

JournalEvent.notes: The API accepts any of these from journal.add. Only notes and quotes are normally written by apps; the rest are journaled by the server as a side effect of library, reads, lists and prompts calls (spec/03 'Journal entries are the server's job'). A manual progress_updated merges into that day's entry.

values.label: Progress updates
values.doc: Written by the server when you use reads.setProgress. A manual entry merges into that day's progress entry.

values.label: Ratings
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.rate or library.update; adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Reviews
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.update with a review; adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Want to read
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.add or library.setStatus; adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Started reading
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.setStatus; adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Finished reading
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.setStatus; adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Paused
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.setStatus; adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Stopped
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.setStatus; adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Started an edition
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.setStatus (Currently Reading starts a read); adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Finished an edition
values.doc: Written by the server when you use library.setStatus (Read finishes the read); adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Added to a list
values.doc: Written by the server when you use lists.addBook or lists.addBooks; adding it yourself duplicates it.

values.label: Prompt answers
values.doc: Written by the server when a book is added to a prompt answer.

values.label: Recommendations sent
values.doc: Written by the server from a library entry's recommendedFor.

values.label: Recommendations received
values.doc: Written by the server from a library entry's recommendedBy.

GoalMetric.notes: Progress is calculated by the server; apps never set it. For hour goals, `goal` is hours and `progress` is seconds (app/rails/app/models/goal.rb computed_progress).

values.label: Hours listened or read
values.doc: The goal is in hours but the API's `progress` is in seconds. Compare them with goalProgress().
